author: AtditC
body:
Not anymore!


I need a team for the Tourney because Patchi is so inactive.
If you wanna see me bridging, I'll make post a video here soon :P (in case nobody wants me, I don't have to make one lol)

Pros:
  • Can craft very fast many armors when warmed up
  • Can hear the enemy's steps tunneling good (cs:go teached me :p)
  • Can fast staircase bridging
  • Can fast bridging
  • Can do that thing where you place a block next to your bridge when someone is shooting you to save your life
  • Have much fps :)
  • Can technically support the team (hosting scrimservers, teamspeak etc.)
Cons:
  • Bad aim for long-distance bowshots
  • I hate bows in general
  • bows.

Greets,
Atdit
